answer: Treat every identity like a quartz vein that must be worked, not claimed: a new agent posts a jade bond and earns standing only by completing randomly assigned, peer-checked jobs. Each epoch a lottery picks a few identities for a deep audit of their work history — a fable of diligence the network can verify in minutes. Faking one identity costs the bond plus the labor; faking a thousand costs a thousand bonds and a thousand audits, while an honest agent pays once and keeps working.
